register.labelZh: KEEP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: KEEP 片語動詞可以叫人遠離、退後、不要踏上某處,或不要進入某個地方。；keep at、keep ahead 和 keep up 可以表示繼續努力、保持領先,以及跟上別人的速度或進度。；你可以使用 KEEP 片語動詞談論控制成本、限制討論、阻止某個行動,或防止他人進入。；KEEP 片語動詞可以表示與可能有幫助的人保持友好、與朋友保持聯絡、了解最新消息,或隱瞞資訊。；KEEP 可以表示噪音令人無法入睡、惡劣天氣令人在室內逗留,或導遊讓小組保持在一起。
register.summaryEn: KEEP expressions can tell people to stay away, stand back, remain off a surface or stay out of a place. Keep at, keep ahead and keep up help you talk about continuing to try, remaining in front and matching another person’s speed or progress. You can use KEEP to talk about controlling costs, limiting a discussion, preventing an action or stopping people from entering. KEEP expressions can describe staying friendly with useful people, keeping in contact with friends, following current news or hiding information. KEEP can show that noise stops someone sleeping, bad weather makes people stay indoors, or a guide makes a group remain together.
